verdict.rationale: Bitbucket stores CI/CD pipeline definitions (bitbucket-pipelines.yml) as code in the repo, and its PR/code-review tooling (bitbucket-docs-11, bitbucket-docs-19) would apply to reviewing changes to those files, with git history enabling rollback — but this is inferred, not explicitly documented as a capability for 'automations' or workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of versioning/reviewing/rolling back Pipelines or AI-triggered workflows (bitbucket-docs-4) specifically, and any audit/history UI for automation runs.
